requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 5,00,00,000 over the preceding three financial years.
The bidder shall submit an EMD of Rs. 9,60,000 online before the bid end date.
The bidder shall have at least 5 years of experience in supplying ambulances fabricated to AIS-125 standards.
MSEs registered under Udyam are exempted from the EMD; startup exemption is not available for this bid.
The bidder shall hold a valid type approval certificate from a notified testing agency for the offered vehicle.
4.1 The supplier shall deliver 24 fully fabricated ambulances to the district headquarters within 120 days of the order.
4.2 The supplier shall provide three years of comprehensive warranty covering the chassis and the medical equipment.
4.3 The supplier must ensure every vehicle carries the medical equipment list specified in Annexure II at handover.
4.4 The supplier shall establish an authorised service point within 100 kilometres of each district headquarters.
4.5 The supplier should train two drivers and two paramedics per district on the installed equipment.
All certificates shall be uploaded as PDF files of not more than 15 MB each.
Bids shall be submitted on the GeM portal before 05:00 PM IST on 15-12-2026.
The bidder shall sign the technical and financial covers with a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate.
The bidder shall upload the AIS-125 type approval certificate and the Udyam certificate where applicable.
Bids will be evaluated on the lowest price per vehicle among technically qualified bidders.
A physical inspection of a sample vehicle may be required before award.
